verdict.rationale: A design platform could plausibly embed an AI assistant that consumes external MCP servers, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents Penpot as an MCP server that external agents connect to, which is the opposite role. The Figma-migration workflow also connects both servers to an external agent rather than to Penpot. There is no evidence that Penpot itself can plug in MCP servers and use their tools.
